notes: Canonical roster of agent directories under agents/. Every subdirectory of agents/ must appear here exactly once; every entry here must correspond to an existing subdirectory. See tests/test_agent_registry.py for the lint. Fields: role (<=12-word purpose), category, cadence, status, artifact_paths, authority_level, supervised_by_orchestrator, owner, notes. supervised_by_orchestrator is DECLARATIVE — active agents default to true (they must be checked by tools/agent_heartbeat_checks.py). Set false only when the agent is intentionally cosmetic/unsupervised, with the reason in notes.
